name: remote-desktop
description: Remote desktop access via xrdp (RDP) and TigerVNC for chadwm

files./etc/xrdp/xrdp.ini:
[Globals]
ini_version=1.0
fork=true
port={{.rdp_port}}
ssl_protocols=TLSv1.2, TLSv1.3
tls_ciphers=HIGH
[Channels]
rdpdr=true
rdpsnd=true
drdynvc=true
cliprdr=true
rail=true
[Logging]
LogLevel=INFO
files./etc/xrdp/sesman.ini:
[Globals]
ListenAddress=127.0.0.1
ListenPort=3350
EnableUserWindowManager=true
UserWindowManager=chadwm
DefaultWindowManager=chadwm
[Security]
AllowRootLogin=false
[Sessions]
X11DisplayOffset=10
MaxSessions=10

ssh_tunnel_only.name: ssh_tunnel_only
ssh_tunnel_only.description: Bind only to localhost / SSH tunnel / Tailscale
